```{r}
library(scales) # Required for scales::squish
if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
  windowsFonts(playfair = windowsFont("Playfair Display"))
}

plt_diff <- ggplot() +
  gg(pred_list$pred_diff %>% filter(time_sec %in% c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30)), geom = "tile", aes(fill = mean, color = mean)) +
  annotate_pitch(
    dimensions = pitch_international,
    fill       = NA,
    colour     = "gray50", 
    alpha      = 0.5
  ) +
  coord_fixed(
    xlim = c(0, 105), 
    ylim = c(0, 68), 
    expand = FALSE 
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ time_sec) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low      = "blue", 
    mid      = "white", 
    high     = "red", 
    midpoint = 0, 
    limits   = c(-2, 2),       # Forces the legend scale to be exactly -1.5 to 1.5
    oob      = scales::squish,     # Caps extreme values at red/blue instead of turning them NA
    name     = "Difference"
  ) +
  scale_colour_gradient2(
    low      = "blue", 
    mid      = "white", 
    high     = "red", 
    midpoint = 0, 
    limits   = c(-2, 2),        
    oob      = scales::squish,
    name     = "Difference"     # <-- Match the name from scale_fill_gradient2
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 5, xend = 25, y = 3, yend = 3,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Playfair Display", base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#1A1A1A", colour = NA), 
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "#DDDDDD", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.title       = element_blank(), 
    axis.text        = element_blank(), 
    axis.ticks       = element_blank(),
    plot.margin      = margin(24, 28, 18, 28),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2", colour = "#DDDDDD", linewidth = 0.4),

    # Top facet labels (Quantiles / Mean)
    strip.text.x = element_text(
      colour = "#111111", 
      size = 12, 
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(t = 8, b = 8)
    ),

    # Side facet labels (Attack / Defense)
    strip.text.y = element_text(
      colour = "#111111", 
      size = 16,           
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(l = 8, r = 8) 
    )
  )

plt_diff
ggsave(here("img" , "fortuna_team_dif.pdf"), plot = plt_diff, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 600, device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsoccer)
library(here)

if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
  windowsFonts(playfair = windowsFont("Playfair Display"))
}

# Define Zone 14 coordinates based on the paper's central attacking region
x_min <- 70
x_max <- 88.5
y_min <- 24
y_max <- 44

p_zone14 <- ggplot() +
  annotate_pitch(dimensions = pitch_international, fill = NA, colour = "gray50") +
  theme_pitch() +
  # Highlight Zone 14
  annotate("rect", xmin = x_min, xmax = x_max, ymin = y_min, ymax = y_max, 
           fill = "red", alpha = 0.4, color = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.5) +
  # Add text label
  annotate("text", x = (x_min + x_max)/2, y = (y_min + y_max)/2, 
           label = "Zone 14", color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 5, family = "Playfair Display") +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(family = "Playfair Display", face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16)
  )

ggsave(here("img" , "zone14.pdf"), plot = p_zone14, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 600, device = cairo_pdf)
```
